Pursuant to Regulation 32(6) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 read with Regulation 173A of the SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018, we are enclosing herewith the Monitoring Agency Report dated November 12, 2026, issued by Crisil Ratings Limited, in respect of use of proceeds raised through the issue of equity shares by way of Qualified Institutional Placement, for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Hitachi Energy India Limited filed a Monitoring Agency Report with the BSE and NSE for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The report, issued by Crisil Ratings Limited, confirms that proceeds from the Qualified Institutional Placement were utilized in accordance with the Offer Document. The net proceeds were revised to Rs. 2,485.37 crore due to lower issue expenses. Rs. 185.48 crore was utilized for capital expenditure during the quarter. Rs. 634.63 crore was utilized from the beginning of the quarter. Rs. 820.11 crore remains utilized in total. Rs. 1,665.26 crore remains unutilized. No deviations from the objects of the issue were reported.

attchmntText: Hitachi Energy India Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Hitachi Energy India Limited filed a statement of deviation or variation for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, regarding funds raised through Qualified Institutional Placement. The company confirms there is no deviation or variation in the use of proceeds from the objects stated in the Placement Document dated March 13, 2025. Gross proceeds were Rs. 2520.82 Crores, with net proceeds revised to Rs. 2,485.37 Crores. This revision reflects the transfer of an unutilized balance of Rs. 9.08 Crores from issue-related expenses to General Corporate Purposes. The Audit Committee reviewed the statement on November 12, 2026. Funds utilized during the quarter amounted to Rs. 820.11 Crores, primarily for capital expenditure. No utilization was reported for working capital or general corporate purposes in this quarter.

attchmntText: Hitachi Energy India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Hitachi Energy India Limited delivers strong Q2FY27 performance: Strong market momentum drives orders, revenue growth and record backlog".
voiceSummary: Hitachi Energy India Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting occurred on November 12, 2026. Revenue from operations was 2,996.51 Crores for the quarter and 5,490.20 Crores for the six months. Profit for the period stood at 318.49 Crores for the quarter and 612.64 Crores for the six months. Earnings per share were 71.46 Rupees for the quarter and 137.45 Rupees for the six months. The statutory auditors, S.R. Batliboi & Associates LLP, issued a review report confirming no material misstatements. The company noted an unutilized amount of 1,665.26 Crores from a previous Qualified Institutions Placement.

attchmntText: Hitachi Energy India Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Hitachi Energy India Limited filed a presentation for its Q2 FY26-27 Analyst Conference Call on November 12, 2026. The company reported revenue of Rs 2,996.5 Crores for the quarter, up 63.5% year-on-year. Profit after tax stood at Rs 318.5 Crores, a 20.5% increase. Orders with HVDC reached Rs 4,120.8 Crores, rising 85.9% year-on-year. The order book as of the period end was Rs 33,335.4 Crores. Growth was driven by transmission, industries, and data centers. The company highlighted safety metrics, including a total recordable injury frequency rate of 0.10. ESG progress included a CRISIL ESG rating of 69. Capacity expansion projects are underway at multiple locations, with most capital expenditure expected to complete by 2028.

voiceSummary: Hitachi Energy India Limited has changed the timing of its investor and analyst conference call regarding financial performance for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The call, scheduled for Thursday, November 12, 2026, has been advanced. It will now be held from 5:00 PM to 6:00 PM IST. The company filed this notice with BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited. The revised invitation is enclosed with the filing. Management participants include Mr. N Venu, Mr. Ajay Singh, and Mr. Poovanna Ammatanda.
